::: {#exm-palindrome}
#### Some palindromes

Over the alphabet of lowercase letters,
$\mathtt{noon}$ and $\mathtt{racecar}$ are palindromes (@def-palindrome),
and so is $\mathtt{abba}$, from @exr-palindrome.
The string $\mathtt{recur}$ is not a palindrome: backward it reads $\mathtt{rucer}$.
The empty string and every string of one symbol are palindromes.

:::
